translations.web: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.
translations.bsb: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, and the ear of the wise seeks it out.
translations.kjv: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.
translations.asv: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; And the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.
